records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of 2022 increased $20.5 million, or 28.5%, to $92.4 million compared with $71.9 million in the first quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Orders booked were $160.9 million during the first quarter of 2022 as compared with $92.1 million during the first quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Some of our facilities and our suppliers have experienced temporary disruptions as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, and we continue to work closely with our global supply chain to proactively support customers during this critical time.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To compare operating performance between the three-month period ended March 31, 2022 and 2021, the Company has adjusted GAAP operating income to exclude (1) amortization of intangible assets, earnout and retention expenses, (2) restructuring expenses primarily relating to severance, facility exits, and associated legal expenses, and (3) acquisition and integration expenses, which include legal, accounting, and other expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income as reported in accordance with GAAP $ 5.2 $ 3.1
